levels.notes: The highest structural risk: a plan without soldiers that can hold path 2 at w16 cannot damage the boss at all. With no rally action, the only levers are which holder gets a barracks (its fixed default_rally_pos) and reinforcements at an anchor. The three exits also make path_progress wrong. Iron mode locks barrack and mage.

cross_level_findings: No click needed for 13-19: none of the five bosses (eb_sarelgaz, eb_gulthak, eb_greenmuck, eb_kingpin, eb_ulgukhai) has dying, tap_decal or a tower-freezing required_clicks modifier, and no tower trap exists on these levels (template dumps; game_scripts main/189, 192, 195). The only clickable entities are achievement easter eggs: decal_fredo L13, decal_scrat L18, decal_frozen_mushroom x5 L19. click_need (alpharush_rl/assets/host.lua:350-361) does not offer them, which is correct. The existing click_entity rule needs no change for 13-19.

No special towers or holders on 13-19: every holder is a standard tower_holder_snow/grass/wasteland with editor.game_mode=0, so BASIC_TOWERS/STANDARD_TOWERS (host.lua:207-213) cover all build options. There is no sunray-like point tower.

Blocking is now the decisive and unexpressible lever. Ulgukhai (L19) can only be damaged while blocked. Kingpin (L17, vis.bans F_BLOCK) and troll skaters on ice (L18/L19, skate.vis_bans_extra=F_BLOCK) cannot be blocked at all. The action space (V2_ACTIONS, host.lua:215-216) has no barracks rally-point or hero-move action, so soldier placement is fixed to each holder's tower.default_rally_pos. Proposal: a set_rally action, or at least a boss-targeted reinforcement anchor.

Power anchors can miss the boss: power_anchors (host.lua:290-314) offers only the 3 front-most enemies by path_progress, 60 px apart. Reinforcements onto Ulgukhai, or rain of fire onto Kingpin or Greenmuck, are only possible when the boss happens to be in that top 3. Proposal: always include live F_BOSS enemies as anchors.

path_progress assumes one exit: get_level_exit picks a single cluster of path ends (Lumi_Nox/games/kingdom_rush/bridge.lua:247-268; same code in runtime alpha_native_bridge.lua:247/436). L17 has 2 defend points and L19 has 3, so progress is wrong for enemies heading to the other exits. Mid-path spawns also make progress jump: L13 cave paths 2/3, L15 random tree spawns and the portal out_node, L18 tunnels placing enemies on paths 5/6.

The enemy observation omits the new states. collect_enemies (bridge.lua:409-440) exports hp, armor, speed and path fields but not health.ignore_damage (Ulgukhai's shield), vis.bans (unblockable or flying) or in_limbo. Tunnel-limbo enemies on L18 stay listed, since they are still e.enemy and not dead, at stale positions (inferred). The operator cannot see these states.

Soldier deaths are punished. L15's graveyard turns every dead non-hero friendly unit into a zombie or swamp thing on path 4 (game_scripts main/310). Greenmuck bombs soldiers, the Kingpin aura does about 1500 raw DPS in r65, Sarelgaz eats blockers, and zapper and demon deaths explode. Main-campaign barracks-heavy priors from the 8B brain may transfer badly to L15/L17.
Enemies untargetable for stretches: L16 invalid_path_ranges (utils find_* skip invalid nodes), L15 portal raise (vis.bans=F_ALL, ignore_damage), L18 tunnel limbo, L19 shielded boss.

Every elite boss has lives_cost 20, equal to the full 20 lives, so any boss leak is an instant loss. Heroic (6 waves) and iron (1 wave) modes have 1 life, no boss, and lock two tower types via level_mode_overrides[3]. Campaign mode alone is enough to clear the levels.

Armor and magic-armor splits are sharper than in levels 1-12: orc_armored 0.8 armor vs orc_rider 0.8 MR (L14), raider 0.95 armor vs pillager 0.9 MR (L16), sarelgaz_small 0.7/0.7 (L13), rotten_tree 0.8 armor (L15). Starting gold ranges from 500 (L16) to 1000 (L19). The per-level GA search should handle composition; the main risk is the boss and blocking mechanics above.

cross_level_findings: Clicks: none of levels 20-26 needs a player click to progress. Moloch, Myconid, Blackburn and Cerberus all die from damage alone: no dying state, no tap_decal, no required_clicks. I scanned all 586 evaluated templates for required_clicks, tap_decal, click_fx and clicks_to_destroy. The only progress-relevant click mechanics in KR1 are eb_jt (tap_decal) plus mod_jt_tower and mod_veznan_tower (required_clicks=3), which the existing click_entity rule already covers (host.lua:350-361). Everything else is cosmetic or optional: easter-egg click_play decals in levels 23-25 (required_clicks on a non-modifier, so correctly not offered), goat and sheep decals, and enemy_sheep_fly/ground (clicks_to_destroy=8, level 26 iron only, also killable by damage). No new click rule is needed to clear the 20-26 campaigns.

Action-space gap 1, dormant bosses: the bridge counts every entity with an enemy component that is not dead (bridge.lua:409-416,738). So the sleeping Cerberus (level 20 campaign) and the seated, damage-immune Moloch (level 21 campaign) keep enemy_count >= 1 from wave 0. The host therefore never offers send_wave after wave 0 (host.lua:475; same condition at host.lua:195,516), and power_anchors (host.lua:290-315) can aim spells at immune targets (inferred). Suggested fix: drop enemies with health.ignore_damage, immune_to == DAMAGE_ALL, vis.bans == F_ALL/-1, or a 'sleeping' or 'sitting' phase from enemy_count and the anchors.

Action-space gap 2, no rally or hero positioning (V2_ACTIONS, host.lua:215-216). Several mechanics punish soldiers standing in the wrong place or dying: burning floors in levels 20/21 sit 13-33 px from the default rally points of holders 6, 8, 9, 14 (level 20) and 1, 2, 13, 14, 15 (level 21). In level 22 every dead non-hero soldier becomes a zombie or swamp thing worth 0 gold. In level 26 Blackburn raises soldiers that die near him as skeleton_big. Moloch instakills groups of 2+ soldiers. Witches turn soldiers into frogs. Plans that rely on barracks should be re-scored on these levels.

Action-space gap 3, special towers: the host only offers STANDARD_TOWERS and POWER_SPECIALS (host.lua:207-213,416) and only 'holder' kind holders (host.lua:403). The level 22 pre-built elf mercenary barracks (tw_buy_soldier soldier_elf, 100 gold, max 4) and the iron-mode tower_elf_holder are therefore unusable. Not required to win, but a free resource is left unused.

Hidden enemies: mega_spawner adds about 417, 435 and 492 campaign enemies on levels 23, 24 and 26 from mid-path grave or house points. They do not appear in the waves files and so not in the next_wave preview (preview content is inferred). A GA build order scored on wave composition will under-estimate pressure and ambushes behind the front towers.

Damage-type gating: spectral knights (levels 24 and 26) have immune_to=26 (physical + explosion + electrical) and armor 1, so they need mage, sorcerer, arcane or true damage. Fallen knights and witches have 0.9 magic armor. Demon-mage shields ignore 4 hits each (levels 20 and 21), which favours fast-hitting towers. Regenerators: swamp thing, werewolf, lycan_werewolf. Several enemies spawn more enemies: legion clones, necromancers, Myconid summons, spider eggs, lycan transformation.

Must-verify anomaly: on level 25, path 7 is fully registered as an invalid range (all 361 nodes invalid in path_db with the level's range applied), and the utils targeting filters require is_node_valid. All 32 campaign witches use path 7. Read literally, the code makes them untargetable (32 x 2 lives), which conflicts with a winnable level. Run a short live headless probe on level 25 (watch whether witches get shot) before planning.

Boss lives_cost is 20 for Moloch, Myconid and Blackburn, so one leak is likely fatal (inferred from a default of 20 lives). Moloch only becomes active in wave 16 (wave_active=16); Myconid and Blackburn spawn at the start of wave 15. Blackburn's tower freeze expires on its own (4 s, about every 5 s, r283.7) and needs no click, but frozen towers are blocked, so the host offers no upgrades on them during that time.

Moon mechanics (zombie speed x2, werewolf moon regen, soldier lycanthropy) are gated on level.moon_controller, which no KR1 level or template defines, so they are inert. Lycan to lycan_werewolf transformation at 25% hp is NOT moon-gated and does happen.

Bonus modes: heroic has 6 waves and iron 1, with different cash. Moloch, Myconid and Blackburn appear only in campaign. Level 26 iron adds the clickable sheep and a pre-built sorcerer tower. Iron mode locks two tower families on most levels (level_mode_overrides[3].locked_towers).

Method and reproducibility: values come from evaluating the bytecode in memory with the game's lua51.dll, read-only from Kingdom Rush.exe.bak, through a scratch harness at <local scratch directory> (with lvl.lua, waves2.lua, spawner2.lua, tpl.lua, enemy.lua). The harness runs entity_db:load() for templates and runs the level, wave and spawner members directly. 'GS main/N' refers to prototypes in game_scripts_protos.txt (kr1/game_scripts.lua); 'GT' means a template evaluated from kr1/game_templates.lua, whose prototype dump is one monolithic main L0-8771. Template hp values are before all/difficulty.lua patch_templates scaling. No project, game or archive file was modified.

progression.unlock_rules:
Elite stages unlock only through CAMPAIGN-mode wins. No star count is required. The rule is utils.unlock_next_levels_in_ranges(unlock_data, levels, GS) with GS.level_ranges = {{1,12},{13},{14},{15,22,list=true},{16,17},{18,19},{20,21},{23,26}} and main_campaign_levels = 12. The map screen runs it on every init and saves when anything changes.

(1) Once levels[12][GAME_MODE_CAMPAIGN] exists (level 12 won in campaign mode, any difficulty), the first level of every elite range is created as an empty entry (levels[n] = {}) in one step: 13 Sarelgaz's Lair, 14 Ruins of Acaroth, 15 Rotten Forest, 16 Hushwood, 18 Glacial Heights, 20 Pit of Fire and 23 Rotwick.

(2) Inside a range, a campaign win on the previous level opens the next one:
- 16 -> 17 Bandit's Lair
- 18 -> 19 Ha'Kraj Plateau
- 20 -> 21 Pandaemonium
- 15 -> 22 Fungal Forest (a 'list' range, so 15 and 22 are paired)
- 23 -> 24 Ancient Necropolis -> 25 Nightfang Swale -> 26 Castle Blackburn
- 13 and 14 stand alone.

I confirmed this by running the game's own function in a sandbox (scratchpad simunlock.py). After 12 is won it unlocks 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, 23. After 16 it unlocks 17; after 15, 22; after 23, 24; after 18, 20 and 24, it unlocks 19, 21 and 25; after 25, 26. A heroic-only win on 12 unlocks nothing.

Heroic and Iron wins never unlock levels. On a first campaign win the map victory handler also adds find_next_level_in_ranges(idx), e.g. 12->13, 15->22, 16->17, 17->18, 22->16, 25->26, 26->26. All of these are already open or the same as the rule above, so the effective unlock graph is the one listed.

If a pending victory (slot.last_victory) is for a level index with no levels[idx] entry, the map ignores it ('victory level %s was not shown in map before').

Endless (level 81) is separate: its flag is gated by is_premium.
progression.stars_and_rewards:
Elite stages do award stars, up to 5 each, exactly like main levels:
- Campaign: 1-3 stars, stored in levels[i].stars. 3 stars if lives_left >= 18, 2 if >= 6, else 1. Campaign starts with 20 lives.
- Heroic win: +1 star (key levels[i][2] present).
- Iron win: +1 star (key levels[i][3] present).

max_stars = 130 = 26 levels x 5. count_stars skips level indexes >= 80, so endless does not count. The main campaign gives at most 60 stars (36 from campaign); the elites add up to 70 (42 from campaign). Re-winning with more lives raises the stored stars.

All stars count toward the star-upgrade budget: UpgradesView.max_stars = screen_map.total_stars = utils.count_stars(user_data) = campaign stars + heroic wins + iron wins. Buying everything costs 65 stars, so 3 campaign stars on all 26 levels (78) covers it without any heroic or iron win.

The in-game TIP_ELITE tip is advisory, not a gate. It shows once, in campaign mode, when level_idx >= 13 and count_stars < 50: 'ELITE STAGE! This is a stage of extreme difficulty. Over 50 stars are recommended to face this stage.'

Gems are shop currency only: gems_per_wave = floor(gems_per_level[i] * gems_factor_per_mode[mode] / waves_count). gems_per_level is 500 for levels 13-26; the mode factors are campaign 0.8, heroic 0.48, iron 0.48.

Heroes do NOT keep levels across stages. In KR1 game_settings.hero_xp_ephemeral = true, so:
- systems.lua does not write hero xp at level end;
- game_gui does not write it on quit or restart;
- storage restore skips hero levels.

insert_hero sets hero.level from heroes.status[h].xp using hero_xp_thresholds {300,900,2000,4000,8000,12000,16000,20000,26000}, which gives levels 1-10. In a normal save xp stays 0, so the hero starts every stage at level 1 and levels up only during the stage. The project's hero_xp > 0 option would start a hero above level 1, which the real game never does.

progression.upgrade_rules:
There are 6 trees (archers, barracks, mages, engineers, rain, reinforcements), each with 5 levels. Prices per level:
- archers, barracks, mages: 1, 1, 2, 2, 3
- engineers: 1, 1, 2, 3, 3
- rain: 2, 2, 3, 3, 3
- reinforcements: 2, 3, 3, 3, 4
Buying everything costs 65 stars. This matches STAR_PRICES in campaign.py:15-16. The budget is all stars earned, including elite, heroic and iron stars.

Per-stage cap: systems.lua applies the slot's upgrade levels, then calls upgrades.patch_templates(store.level.max_upgrade_level). That value comes from levelNN_data.lua after level_utils.load_data merges level_mode_overrides[level_mode].

For every elite level 13-26 the cap is 5 in all modes, so there is no cap. There are also no campaign or heroic tower locks on elites. By contrast, levels 1-9 use campaign overrides to lock advanced towers, and their heroic/iron overrides cap upgrades at 2-4 and lock the hero. map_data level_data[i].upgrades.{level, heroe} is only the challenge-page text ('lvl 5 max', 'HEROES') for these overrides.
progression.save_slot_format:
Game format: slot_%d.lua contains a Lua table.
- Required keys: levels, upgrades, heroes. If any is missing, load_slot deletes the slot.
- Defaults are filled in for missing optional keys (gems = 0).
- The template also has achievements, bag, gems and seen, plus heroes.status[13 heroes] = {skills = {}, xp = 0}.
- save_slot adds version_string.
- heroes.selected is set by the hero room; user_data.difficulty is the global difficulty.
- last_victory = {level_idx, level_mode, level_difficulty, stars} is written by systems.lua on a win and consumed by the next map init.

Each levels[i] entry works like this:

audit.summary:
Short answer: the current architecture can plausibly be taken to the 14 elite levels in campaign/Normal mode, with targeted changes rather than a redesign.

**What already works.**
- The direct '-level N -mode 1' launch has no unlock check (all/director.lua main/30).
- Earlier survey and teacher runs already loaded all of levels 13-26.
- Cold replays were deterministic on levels 16, 21 and 24.
- Campaign-mode elite rules are the standard ones: no tower locks and all 5 upgrade levels.
- The search, collect and eval validators, the profile and slot writer, the hero list and the star logic have no level caps.
- No elite boss needs a click: no tap_decal or required_clicks in their scripts, and Blackburn's tower block is timed.

**Hard limits in the code.**
- campaign_run.check_campaign only accepts levels 1..N, and the runner stops at the first failed level. In the game, elite levels unlock as 7 independent chains after level 12 (utils main/135 plus level_ranges).
- operator_net MAX_LEVEL=12 one-hot: levels 13-26 get a zero vector, and changing it invalidates the trained weights.
- Governance: the campaign-v1 phase's native-final and survey/verify/teacher jobs are used up, the final seeds 6001-6005 are spent, and the approval text runs only until 2026-10-06 19:00. A new phase/pools config is needed, with a new approval from the user in chat.

**Elite-specific risks.**
- The bridge measures path progress against a single exit, but levels 17, 19, 24 and 26 have 2-3 exits.
- Untargetable enemies (the sleeping Cerberus on level 20, the sitting Moloch on level 21) count as live enemies. This blocks early wave calls and can attract spell anchors.
- Boss detection by the 'eb_' prefix misses the level 20 Cerberus.

**Action gaps.** In priority order: barracks rally points (the bridge has it, the host does not expose it), hero movement, spells aimed at path points rather than enemies, and buying elves on level 22. Special or blocked holders and click mechanics are not needed for campaign-mode elite play.

**Fidelity only.** slot_lua unlocks only max+1.
